sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Water Release, Stable, Barrier

system.description:
You swirl boiling chakra into your muscles before expelling it into a thin barrier for the duration. When this jutsu is cast, you gain 10 temporary hit points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack before the end of the jutsu’s duration, they take 5 acid damage.

At the beginning of each of your turns, if you have less than the maximum temporary hit points granted by this jutsu, you regain 10 temporary hit points.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the temporary hit points gained by +10 and the damage by +5. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, when you take damage from an attack, you can choose to cause the steam, barrier to instead be expelled outward like a shockwave, affected all creatures within 10 feet of you, dealing damage to each creature within range equal to the listed acid damage.
